marc: Heads up — seeing steady VRAM growth in kvcache with paged-attn on long-context runs. H100 vs MI250 behave differently, looks like PT churn + reuse misses. :thinking:

anya: repro script? where did you run it?

marc: small repro on bert-longseq harness, 128k tokens streamed over multiple prompts. Paged KV enabled, eviction policy=LRU-prefetch. Ran on h100-80gb and mi250x. Attached top counters below.

marc: ```
KVCache: pages_allocated=4821 pages_in_use=4672 page_table_entries=4750
KVCache: evict_attempts=1206 evict_success=1189 reuse_hits=341 reuse_misses=447
Pager: walk_time_ms=1234.7 stall_count=84 kernel=tiled_attn_v2
GPU: hwm=68GB resident=69.8GB (leak slow)
```

devon: mi250x trace shows similar page_table growth but higher evict_success, lower stall_count. h100 has more long-tail reuse misses — suspect kernel memory layout prevents coalesced page frees.

anya: did kernel selection change during run? any fallbacks?

marc: yes — runtime switches kernel based on sequence length distribution. For longctx we fall back to 'unified_attn' path on H100 which pins extra kv metadata per page. Swapping to 'tiled_attn_v3' reduced resident by ~2.4GB in quick test.

profiling-bot: perf snapshot saved: perf/6423456789/kv_pagetable_h100_hotwalk.pb.gz

devon: interesting — that suggests kernel alloc patterns interact with page allocation granularity. Could be allocator fragmentation + page table tombstones. We should add per-page-owner tags and count tombstones over time.

anya: agree. quick checklist: add counters for page_owner, tombstone_count, last_access_ts histogram. Also capture kernel id at allocation time.

marc: I'm also seeing a small correlation with batching heuristics — when batch size distribution has many small batches we get more frequent prefix evictions, which increases page churn. When we force larger batching windows churn drops.

devon: that could explain why hosted runs (steady batch sizes) don't see it. For dedicated noisy bursts we do. Add a flag to disable small-batch aggressive eviction to test.

marc: plan: 1) add per-page lifetime telemetry + kernel_at_alloc tag; 2) run cross-arch A/B: h100 vs mi250 w/ tiled_attn_v3 forced; 3) try softer eviction policy + batch-window smoothing; 4) collect perfshots and memgraphs. I'll push a small patch with counters.

anya: if we confirm kernel interaction, upstream option is to prefer kernels that minimize metadata per allocation on H100, or collapse metadata into shared slab.

infra-bot: created issue RW-8312: "kvcache: per-page owner tags + kernel-at-alloc telemetry" and CI job kv-longctx-e2e added.

marc: small repro patch landed in my branch marc/kvcache/pagetable-telemetry, test run queued. Will post perf links when available. :thumbsup:

devon: also add a test that runs longctx workload with page-table snapshot diff after N steps so we can detect monotonic growth in CI.

marc: good call — adding that to the PR.

anya: tl;dr: likely interaction between kernelselection and allocator/page-table representation causing higher fragmentation and slower reuse on H100; next step is telemetry and controlled A/B to narrow root cause.

devon: thanks — i'll help with profiler parsing once the perfshots land.

marc: thanks team.
